candidates.note: Four narrative reliefs form a baptismal font: The Baptism of Christ, Mary with Jesus and John, Three Hovering Angels, and Christ Blessing the Children. The capture shows the assembled font model, rather than an isolated relief. The museum catalogues the individual plaster reliefs as original models: A555,1 is dated no earlier than 1804–1805; A555,2–A555,4 are dated 1806–1808. Published dimensions apply to each relief; the complete assembly’s dimensions remain unconfirmed.
candidates.source_description:
Baptismal font, Christ's baptism (1805-1807), Bertel Thorvaldsen (1770-1844), plaster (77.8 x 72.5 cm). Thorvaldsen Museum (Copenhagen, Denmark). MAde with Memento Beta (ReMake) from Autodesk.

Part of Baptismal font (A555) with a total of four reliefs: A555,1 A555,2 A555,3 and A555,4

For more updates, please follow @GeoffreyMarchal on Twitter.
